playbook.stay_safe: Tornado. Reduce or hedge now; expect gaps, wide spreads and margin calls.

ideas.title: Hedge the delta first
ideas.detail: Realised vol is 28.4% annualised, 8.0x the calm 3.5% (about +/-1.49% a day). An offsetting forward or futures position in USDJPY cuts the loss one for one and stays cheap to put on even after option premia have jumped.

ideas.title: Long volatility, with defined risk
ideas.detail: Options now price a storm. Prefer a spread (a put spread or a strangle financed by selling further wings) over an outright straddle: it pays if the move extends and caps what you lose if vol collapses.

ideas.title: Carry unwind under way
ideas.detail: The long side earns about 3.0% a year in carry and is being squeezed out while the forward curve dislocates. That is the crowded exit: cut or hedge carry positions rather than add to them.

playbook.whats_next: POST /simulate for the P&L fan from this regime.
playbook.opportunity: Volatility is 8.0x its baseline: optionality is expensive, so hedged sellers of vol and liquidity providers are paid most now; wait for the score to roll over before fading the move.
